integrity: Exact proof supplied; standard-library exhaustive checker independently exercises specified finite instances. Finite computations are not used to infer the unbounded statement.
scientific_limitations: Classification is restricted to shifted single transpositions of two distinct nonzero elements on binary vector spaces of dimension at least 3, with full state including carrier. No classification of all nonlinear Yang–Baxter maps or projected site-only periods. Broader priority comparisons and independent mathematical validation remain outstanding.
title: Exact mixed two- and four-cycle spectrum for nonlinear helical transposition maps
